title: Claude Code (default)
description: Claude Code on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: Claude Code (Standard)
de.description: Claude Code an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: your Claude login (sandbox-ai login claude once, or the host's) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; Anthropic's hosts are open by default, nothing else of the provider's. A server of yours instead: the preset claude-local-llm.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-claude or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
